## Requirements

1. `Embedder` — OpenAI-compatible embeddings over the local lane
   (`openai-compatible@1` → `POST {endpoint}/embeddings`) and the OpenAI
   lane (`openai@1`); dimension + served model id recorded; retrieval
   tests over the hermetic benchset re-run with a committed recorded
   embedding cache (replayable offline). Anthropic lane → typed
   `Unsupported` (provider has no embeddings API — verified
   platform.claude.com 2026-10-22: "Anthropic does not offer its own
   embedding model").
2. `Summarizer` — over `GatewayModel` (the lane's dialect/transport/
   credential machinery) with the compaction contract's usage/provenance
   intact (`SummarizerOutput.usage` = provider's own record).
3. `ProviderCompaction` — Anthropic `anthropic-messages@1` binds the
   server-side compaction API (`POST /v1/messages` +
   `compaction:{type:"summarize"}` + `anthropic-beta: compact-2026-09-04`
   → `content[]{type:"compaction", content, signature}`,
   `stop_reason:"compaction"`; verified 2026-10-22). OpenAI:
   `/responses/compact` exists but returns an opaque non-human item (the
   port's `summary_text` contract is unsatisfiable) and lives on the
   Responses surface, not the lane's chat-completions dialect → typed
   `Unsupported`. Local Ollama: no compaction API → `Unsupported`.
4. Live leg `context-adapters` in `scripts/live-verify.sh`: local
   embedding batch + local summarization + hosted OpenAI embedding;
   names `HH_LOCAL_BASE_URL HH_LOCAL_MODEL OPENAI_API_KEY` (all
   `provided: yes` at orient); USD ≤ 5 (R4.7b allocation);
   `pricing.json` gains the `openai/text-embedding-3-small` pin.
5. ADR-0253/ADR-0313 fired-answered note → `docs/build/reports/` (never
   appended to the landed ADRs); BL-31 row progress note.

## Plan

- `hh-gateway/http_transport.rs`: the raw `POST {endpoint}/{op}` leg
  (`probe_post`) becomes the public `post_op(credential, endpoint, op,
  body, extra_headers)` — the one wire/codec home the non-chat ops ride
  (CC1); `anthropic-beta` rides `extra_headers` for the compaction call.
- `hh-embed/src/gateway_model.rs`: `GatewayModel::one_shot(mc)` — the
  driver-free single call (requested_members + call + terminal_members +
  take_model_io), returning `OneShot{text, usage, usage_raw,
  served_model, outcome, model_io}`; `finish_call` stashes the completed
  message text for it.
- `hh-embed/src/context_adapters.rs` (new, pub): `AdapterLane` spec →
  `LaneEmbedder` (trait `hh_context::retrieve::Embedder`, ppm-scaled i64
  quantization — `parse_provider` carries float lexemes verbatim as
  `Json::Str`), `LaneSummarizer` (`hh_context::compact::Summarizer` via
  `GatewayModel::one_shot`; `Overflow`/`Error`/`Empty`/`Aborted` mapping),
  `LaneProviderCompaction` (`compact_family::ProviderCompaction`;
  Messages-family only — others `EmbedError::Unsupported{by}` at arm).
- `crates/hh-embed/tests/r4_7b.rs` — hermetic loopback provider (r4_5d
  shape) replaying recorded responses; request-shape assertions; the
  benchset retrieval re-run over the committed `embedding_cache.json`.
- `crates/hh-embed/tests/r4_7b_live.rs` — three ignored cells (local
  embed batch, local summarize, openai embed); `CTX_*` markers;
  `HH_EMBED_CACHE_OUT` capture path writes the committed fixture once.
- `scripts/live-verify.sh` — `context-adapters` leg; `pricing.json` —
  `openai/text-embedding-3-small` pin ($0.02/1M input).
- Docs: `docs/build/reports/2026-10-22-adr-0253-0313-trigger.md`,
  BL-31 row progress note, run ledger, pr/R4.7b.md, BUILD_INDEX/LEDGER.

## Evidence report

R4.7b discharges BL-31's adapter member and answers ADR-0253/ADR-0313's
fired triggers with real lane-backed context adapters —

- `Embedder` (`LaneEmbedder`): OpenAI-compatible `embeddings` op, live
  on `openai@1` (`text-embedding-3-small`, dim 1536, 91 input tokens,
  `LIVE_MODEL` recorded), local leg typed-refused by the capability-
  absent provisioned endpoint (recorded, never fabricated);
  `anthropic-messages@1` arms `Unsupported` (no embeddings API —
  verified 2026-10-22). The recorded `hh-embedding-cache/1` fixture
  replays the benchset retrieval offline (deterministic ppm cosine).
- `Summarizer` (`LaneSummarizer`): `GatewayModel::one_shot` — the
  lane's own streaming call with the port's closed error lattice
  (Overflow/Empty/Aborted/Error); live on the local lane (90 in / 37 out tokens,
  usage.view folded).
- `ProviderCompaction` (`LaneProviderCompaction`): Anthropic on-demand
  compaction bound and executed live on `claude-haiku-5-5`
  (`stop_reason:compaction`; `forgotten_ids:None` → `all_prior` verbatim
  — ADR-0313 (b)'s narrowing condition verified absent; billed counts in
  `usage.iterations` — a real-doc correction landed). Other families →
  typed `Unsupported` (the openai compact endpoint answers an opaque
  Responses item — cannot serve `summary_text`).
- Wiring: the session's armed `model_port` lane feeds
  `KernelContext.adapter_lane` at open and resume; `Similarity`
  retrieval and the model-calling compaction ops arm the adapters —
  arm-time refusal keeps the typed unbound rows.

Live spend: $0.000131 measured (+$0.05 declared-bound debit on the
recorded failed attempt) vs the $5 R4.7b allocation; cumulative
$15.252252 of $100. Secrets stayed names-only (`provided: yes` ×4).

## Deviations

- **Size overrun (STOP-committed, surfaced).** 3,107 changed lines
  excluding generated artifacts and the committed cache fixture vs the
  800 budget (≈3.9×; 2,516 excl. the docs/build records/evidence) — the adapter module (750), the hermetic + live
  batteries (1,492), boundary wiring (`open.rs`/`runtime.rs`/`lib.rs`),
  `one_shot` + `post_op` (108), the leg machinery + pricing pin (96),
  and the fired-trigger/evidence/run records (504) are one atomic
  scope: a partial adapter leg carries no live evidence, and the
  batteries are the fail-if-removed coverage the ticket demands. Tenth
  consecutive live-track overrun → GATE-G7 pattern: the run stops
  committed and surfaces; the operator's merge gate on the PR is the
  decision point.
